chunks: Al-Kafi: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Sahl ibn Ziyad, all together, from Ibn Mahbub from Jamil ibn Salih, from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The one who has memorized the Qur'an and acts upon it is with the Honourable and Virtuous Scribes.

key_terms.الْعَامِلُ بِهِ: The one who acts upon it

ai.seo_question: Who are the Safarah al-Kiram al-Bararah and who joins them?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elevates the status of the Qur'an memorizer who actively implements its rulings to that of the 'Safarah al-Kiram al-Bararah,' the noble and virtuous angels who record deeds. This comparison underscores that practical adherence to the Qur'an is not merely an intellectual exercise but a spiritual state that aligns the believer with the celestial recorders, granting them a unique proximity to divine knowledge and honor.

en.ammaar-muslim: [4/1544] al-Kafi: A number of our companions from Ahmad b. Muhammad and Sahl b. Ziyad all together from Ibn Mahbub from Jamil b. Salih from al-Fudhayl b. Yasar from Abi Abdillahعليه السلام who said:
The one who has memorized the Qur’an and acts upon it is with the Honourable and Virtuous Scribes
